Home/Kitchen & bathroom updates

Kitchen & bathroom updates

New fixtures.
A useful fresh start.

Planning a new basin, sink, faucet, or a larger room update? Bring the idea and the details you have so far.

Plan a fixture update
01

Make the connections part of the plan.

A fixture’s appearance is only one part of the choice. Existing connections, available space, water supply, drainage, and access need to work with it. Discuss compatibility before ordering equipment.

02

Coordinate with the rest of the room.

Cabinetry, tiling, worktops, and plumbing often depend on one another. A clear sequence helps avoid decisions being made after access is closed or finishes are complete.

  • The fixture models you are considering
  • Room plans and cabinet positions
  • Whether connections will move
  • The intended renovation schedule
03

Agree on the work before it starts.

Ask what removal, installation, testing, and finishing are included. If other trades are involved, clarify who is responsible for each part. The request form can carry your fixture choice into the conversation.

Leaks & fixtures

A dripping faucet, water under the basin, or a fixture that needs attention. Start with where you see the water.

Drains & blockages

A shower that drains slowly, a sink that backs up, or more than one fixture affected. Explain what happens when you run the water.
